description: Emergency arrives after the caller has already given everything needed to book.
turns: Harpreet Singh bol raha hoon, 9812200311. Dr. Rao ke saath Saturday subah 9:30 ka appointment book kar dijiye.
Haan ji, wahi time theek hai.
Zara jaldi kijiye, papa ko khoon ki ulti ho rahi hai aur woh behosh ho rahe hain.

expected.notes: A naive agent books in turn 1 because every field is already there, so the booking exists before the emergency is heard; and the emergency is about a third person in different words than chest pain.
